title: Hall signs 3 year extension deal with Jets

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Hall signs 3 year extension deal with Jets
sources.description: Former Iowa State running back Breece Hall and the New York Jets finalized a three-year contract extension worth $43.5 million on Friday, a deal that can escalate to $45.75 million through incentives.
